10555.text:
10555 * rakṣāpuṭaka 'layer of ashes'. [ rakṣā-², puṭa -] G. rākhɔṛɔ m., °ṛī f. 'layers of ashes or clay &c.,
ashes'.

10553.text:
10553 * rakṣākuṇḍaka 'ash-pit'. [ rakṣā-², kuṇḍá -¹] M. rākhõḍā , °khũḍā m. 'ash-heap, ash-pit, any place
for ashes'.
